- No file changes detected in this release.
- Version incremented to 1.1.0 without modifications to code or documentation.
- No new features, fixes, or updates introduced.

Initial release of ai-newsletter-toolkit.

- Automates data harvesting from X and GitHub via integration with Scrapling.
- Summarizes complex technical developments using LLM logic.
- Enables multi-channel distribution to Threads, Email, and GitHub.
- Optimizes newsletters for discovery by AI agents (Generative Engine Optimization).
- Targeted for independent builders seeking automated, high-impact newsletter creation.
